title.value: Robustness assessment of hyperspectral image CNNs using metamorphic testing
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Robustness assessment of hyperspectral image CNNs using metamorphic testing

extractions.description: The paper proposes a systematic testing method to assess the robustness of CNNs trained to classify Hyperspectral Images (HSIs) by elaborating domain-specific metamorphic transformations that simulate naturally-occurring distortions of remote sensing HSIs. It assesses the robustness of established and novel CNNs for HSI classification, and demonstrates their failure, on average, in 25% of the produced test cases. Furthermore, the tested CNNs are fine-tuned on training data augmented with these failure-revealing metamorphic transformations.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: Remote sensing and hyperspectral image analysis are essential tools in ecology for observing, identifying, controlling, and predicting natural and anthropogenic phenomena on the surface of the Earth.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Natural and anthropogenic phenomena occurring on the surface of the Earth can be observed, identified, controlled, and even predicted with remote sensing tools and technologies. Using them has become essential in a wide range of fields, including ecology, geology, and military surveillance
